Question Choices: Rewrite the subtraction as an addition, then evaluate: (-6) - (-11). Fill in the blanks: (-6) + ___ = ___.
Hints: Take the indicated opposite first; subtraction means adding the opposite of what is subtracted.
Solution: The opposite of -11 is 11, so (-6) - (-11) = (-6) + 11 = 5. Keep the two operations separate: opposite(a) = −a, and b − a = b + (−a). Exact check: 11 = 11; -6-(-11) = 5.

Question Choices: Select the property shown by (-2/3 + 1/5) + 4/5 = -2/3 + (1/5 + 4/5): ~~Associative property of addition | Commutative property of addition | Additive identity~~
Hints: Commutative changes order; associative changes grouping. Opposites add to zero.
Solution: The addends stay in the same order but the parentheses move, which is the associative property of addition. Reorder or regroup addends with signs attached. Opposite pairs sum to zero; adding zero leaves the other amount unchanged.

Hints: Take the indicated opposite first; subtraction means adding the opposite of what is subtracted.
